description: issue #775 (review gate, QA finding B5): `every :t` where `:t` is a TURTLE -- the twin of `wait/wait-turtle-type-error`, and the seventh and last arm of `params.actual` for the shared whole-number check. `spec/error-model.md` requires an `ol-type` to name the learner concept, and `turtle` is a first-class value (`spec/turtles-and-sprites.md`), so a turtle count must be reported as a turtle -- not silently relabelled. Mislabelling ONLY this arm passed a fully green run until these two fixtures existed (found by mutation). Unlike the `dict` and `record` arms -- deliberately not fixtured, see this directory's README -- a turtle's `params.value` serialises faithfully as `{ "id": 1 }`, the exact shape `sprites/turtle-type-diagnostic` already binds. Needs the Sprites profile only to CONSTRUCT the turtle (`new_turtle`); the check under test is the Interaction one. The `spawn-turtle` event from the assignment precedes the `every` registration instruction; the check fails BEFORE registration, so no `primitive` event is emitted and no handler is registered, and the span covers just the count argument.

diagnostics.message: every needs a whole number, but got a turtle.
